title: A LASSO-selected snoRNA signature stratifies head-neck cancer survival
summary: A LASSO-Cox pipeline selected a five-snoRNA expression signature from TCGA head-and-neck cancer data. A 357-patient training set and 153-patient internal test set supported retrospective survival stratification. Functional interpretations came from coexpression and enrichment rather than perturbation experiments. The signature requires external validation and does not establish clinical benefit or a causal role for the RNAs.

source_review.scope: Primary full paper relevant model Methods, study Results and limitations; exact primary front-matter identity and Europe PMC metadata checked.

evidence.tested: Retrospective TCGA training/test survival analysis with 510 patients and training-only signature selection.
evidence.unknown: External validation, causal RNA functions and model-guided care benefit remain unestablished.
evidence.ai_role: LASSO regularization reduces survival-related snoRNAs before multivariable Cox modeling and internal prognostic evaluation.
